Summary: This bill would require the Chief Administrative Law Judge to maintain and establish an online portal to allow respondents to submit photographic or documentary proof that they have cured a violation. The online system must have a mobile-friendly responsive design and must be available in all citywide designated languages.
Text:
A Local Law to amend the New York city charter, in relation to enabling respondents to submit proof of cured violations

Be it enacted by the Council as follows:


Section 1. Chapter 45-A of the New York city charter is amended by adding a new section 1049-c to read as follows:  
§ 1049-c. Submission of proof of cured violations. a. The chief administrative law judge shall establish and maintain an online system to allow respondents to submit photographic or documentary proof of a cured violation for notices of violation that are curable pursuant to law or rules. Such online system shall have a mobile-friendly responsive design and shall be available in all designated citywide languages as defined in subdivision a of section 23-1101 of the code. 
b. Any agency that issues notices of violation returnable to the environmental control board or a tribunal of the office of administrative trials and hearings shall review submissions on the online system for any such notice of violation issued by that agency to determine whether the submission demonstrates that the violation has been cured. An agency determination that a violation has been cured shall have the legal effect provided by the law or rule authorizing the cure. 
§ 2. This local law takes effect 180 days after it becomes law.
